schemaNote: Reusable regional country-directory data model for GPIR Europe / SEPA, following the same shape as assets/data/apac-countries.json and assets/data/latam-countries.json. SEPA (Single Euro Payments Area) is a payment-scheme geographical scope defined by the European Payments Council (EPC) — it is NOT synonymous with EU membership or Euro Area (monetary union) membership. Each country record therefore carries euMember, eeaMember and euroArea as independent booleans alongside sepaMember, so the UI never conflates the three. 'status' drives whether a directory entry is clickable: active = a real, published Country Intelligence page exists; coming_soon = the country is on the GPIR roadmap but no page is published yet. 'operationalReadiness' intentionally stays generic and non-numeric for every country: GPIR has not independently verified per-institution SEPA scheme adherence or PSP operational readiness for any market, so geographical scope (sepaMember/sepaStatus) is never presented as proof that every bank in that country processes every SEPA scheme.
regionDescriptor: SEPA payment-scheme geography, EU/EEA/Euro Area classification, UK payments intelligence and cross-border payment intelligence across Europe.
sepaScopeSource: European Payments Council (EPC) SEPA geographical scope

subRegions.label: Euro Area
subRegions.description: EU member states that have adopted the euro as their currency and are formal Euro Area (ECB monetary union) members.

subRegions.label: EU — Non-Euro
subRegions.description: EU member states that retain their own national currency outside the Euro Area.

subRegions.label: EEA / Non-EU
subRegions.description: European Economic Area members that are not EU member states.

subRegions.label: Non-EEA SEPA
subRegions.description: SEPA geographical-scope participants that are neither EU nor EEA members.

subRegions.label: United Kingdom
subRegions.description: A separate, highly visible SEPA participant — not EU, not EEA, not Euro Area.
